name: Combat and Long-Range Strike Intensity
title: Russia–Ukraine War · Combat and Long-Range Strike Intensity

definition.question: How intense is fighting on the front lines and long-range strikes on cities and rear logistics?
definition.low_end: Sporadic shelling and limited long-range strikes with a largely static front and few impacts on cities or rear logistics.
definition.high_end: Continuous high-tempo offensives and mass missile/drone salvos overwhelming air defenses, with widespread strikes on cities, logistics and rear areas causing mass casualties.
